source_note: 逐张查看钟楼Gary Todd 2011近正面、鼓楼Wang Zhongyin 2010南面斜正视、源義信2023鼓楼山面照片。图版将两座建筑分开并置：钟楼方形台基、四角攒尖顶；鼓楼长方形台基、长屋脊歇山顶。现实两楼并非图中近距离排列。首稿将鼓楼山面的楼梯错置到南面，定向编辑已移除，并稀疏化过密屋瓦线。最终按照片现存形态描绘，省略街景、文字和游客，不代表测绘正立面。
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the current two-tower drawing to correct. Image 2 is the sparse thin-line style master. Image 3 is the actual Bell Tower reference; Image 4 is the actual Drum Tower south facade reference.
Keep exactly two complete buildings, their different roof forms, THREE visible eave lines each, all floor and column counts, comparative sizes and the white background.
1. On the RIGHT DRUM TOWER ONLY, REMOVE the invented paired front stair flights and all stair balustrades from the broad front face of the raised platform. The actual SOUTH facade in Image 4 has NO paired front stair flights. It is a PLAIN tall rectangular brick wall with ONE central arched passage. Keep the simple railing around the platform top; leave the large wall surface white, with only outer boundary and arch outlines. Do NOT remove the stair flights on the LEFT BELL TOWER: those stairs are in its reference photo.
2. Simplify line density on BOTH buildings, especially roofs. Remove about 85 percent of tightly repeated roof tile ribs, leaving at most 6–10 widely spaced very fine roof-direction lines on each large roof slope and mainly white roof surfaces. Reduce repetitive bracket and balustrade miniature details to a few light structural strokes. Preserve the unmistakable roof silhouettes, corner ornaments, finial, long ridge, roof tips, columns and main balconies. Make roof and bracket interiors as sparse as the style master. Do not add shading or grey wash.
3. Give the whole composition a little more horizontal breathing room: maintain a clear gap between the two monuments and at least 5 percent canvas white margin outside each extreme base/roof edge. Keep bases roughly level.
Pure thin BLACK linework on pure WHITE, all arch interiors and windows WHITE, no solid dark under-eave bands, no hatch, brick-grid or pencil texture. No text, frame or labels. Landscape1536×1024.
initial_prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: ONE coordinated fine-line architectural plate for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER: match the Vairocana Buddha drawing's elegant thin slightly organic contours, sparse details and generous white surfaces. Image 2 is SUBJECT GEOMETRY for Xi'an BELL TOWER 钟楼, a near-frontal daylight photo. Image 3 is SUBJECT GEOMETRY for Xi'an DRUM TOWER 鼓楼, showing its long south facade and east gable. Image 4 is the actual Drum Tower's short gable end, only to clarify roof shape; do NOT use the short end as the primary facade.
Create a wide comparative composition of exactly TWO distinct complete monuments: BELL TOWER on the LEFT, DRUM TOWER on the RIGHT. This is an editorial pairing, not a continuous real street scene. Separate them with a clear generous white gap. Put bases on roughly the same baseline, both at a consistent architectural scale. Bell Tower approx 36m tall on 35.5m-wide square platform; Drum Tower approx 33–35m tall on a 53m-wide rectangular platform. Therefore the right Drum Tower should be about 1.45 times as wide as the left Bell Tower but slightly shorter.
LEFT Bell Tower: compact square brick platform with one visible central arched passage and small side depth; retain the actual symmetrical stair flights and stone parapet visible in Image 2. Above it, a square two-floor timber pavilion with THREE distinct projecting eave levels. Top roof is FOUR-SIDED PYRAMIDAL / four-corner tent roof converging to ONE central pointed cup-shaped finial. No horizontal top ridge or gable triangle on Bell Tower. Preserve the actual five-bay central facade plus peripheral corridor columns, open upper balcony, thin columns and the broad empty panels between structural members.
RIGHT Drum Tower: broad RECTANGULAR brick platform, a single central arched passage on the long SOUTH facade. Above it a long rectangular two-floor timber hall, main facade seven bays plus surrounding corridor; show the long south facade almost head-on with a small glimpse of the right gable to clarify the architecture. Its roof is HIP-AND-GABLE XIESHAN with a LONG HORIZONTAL RIDGE, and the upper storey has double eaves plus the lower floor's separate waist roof, giving THREE visible eave lines. It must NOT have the Bell Tower's single pyramidal apex. Preserve the long balcony, slender colonnade and a few simple outlined small drums behind the bottom colonnade, omitting all lettering. Retain rectangular outline plaque as an EMPTY panel if visible. Do not replace this with Beijing Drum Tower.
Refined sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE. Thin confident outlines with a few finer structural lines. All wall, roof, door, window, arch-passage and balcony areas remain WHITE inside outlines. No black shadows, no grey wash, no hatching, no solid dark under-eaves, no brick grids, no dense roof tile fill, no stone/pencil texture. Hint at a few roof ridges and bracket units only, do not copy every tile or decorative painting.
Landscape 1536×1024. Both complete top ornaments, all roof tips, stairs and full platform bases inside the canvas, total group about 83% width, ample top/bottom and side margins. Near-frontal facade-level view, verticals vertical, restrained side depth. Only a few short ground lines below each separate monument. Remove traffic, people, trees, street lamps, modern signs, barriers, flowerbeds, neighbouring buildings and sky. No labels, letters, calligraphy, captions, dimensions, watermark, frame, border or color. Do not merge or duplicate buildings and do not omit either monument.

dating_note: 一条合并记录涵盖鼓楼1380始建、钟楼1384始建；排序year1380取鼓楼沿革起点，不是两楼共有竣工年。钟楼1582迁至现址并重筑基座，单列迁建事件，绝不将现址台基记成1384。明清屡经修葺，图版对应现状。

site_recommendation.name: 西安钟楼 · 鼓楼
site_recommendation.era: 洪武始建 · 万历迁建
site_recommendation.place: 陕西西安 · 府城中心
site_recommendation.lede: 钟楼以攒尖顶立在街道交会处，鼓楼的长屋脊横展于北院门南端。两座明代楼阁曾以钟鼓声报告城中时辰。
facts: 鼓楼始建于1380年，钟楼始建于1384年；钟楼于1582年迁至现址并另筑基座，不能把现址台基等同原址始建年代。
钟楼为方台上的三重檐四角攒尖楼阁；鼓楼台基呈长方形，楼身面阔七间、有周廊，上层为重檐歇山顶。
图版将钟楼与鼓楼分别取近正面并置，保留各自完整轮廓；这是双主体组合图，并非两楼实际相邻的景象。
